newsitem.title: USA: IPC taps Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
newsitem.headline: IPC taps Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.

text.p: IPC Information Systems Inc said Wednesday it hired Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to advise it on strategies to improve shareholder value.

Terry Clontz, president and chief executive officer, said a number of interesting opportunities, including potential alliances and partnerships, has compelled the company to re-evaluate its business plan.
"DMG will assist in evaluating and prioritizing those opportunities," he said.
IPC provides integrated multimedia communications solutions to the financial trading industry. It has customers in more than 30 countries.
Its products include the digital Tradenet MX, a voice trading system. Through its subsidiary, IXnet, IPC connects trading companies with customers and counterparts around the world.
